o1.biggest_strength: It takes the 4.0 apart against the 2.5 break-even, puts the feed fix first, and moves the cut money to bags and the customer's own search words inside the fixed $240,000.
o1.biggest_mistake: Some projections are optimistic and the reserve rule adds a layer of complexity the owner may not want in month one.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Trim the projection table to two credible cases with the working shown and confirm the price-mismatch root cause before leaping to the target-ROAS change.

o2.biggest_strength: Clean profit view by line and a strong feed diagnosis with the 15.6% of site revenue at stake.
o2.biggest_mistake: It claims brand terms are 50% of value when the brief's numbers make it about 41% of PMax value and 50% only if you add brand search, which muddles the core insight; the base case ROAS 4.6 and profit jump look too rosy.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Get the brand share right and make the projections conservative and traceable line by line.

reason: Both get the big calls right, but Output 1's plan is tighter, more defensible on numbers and gives a first-week sequence I could run tomorrow with less rework.
